verdict.rationale: Docs show a Buyer Agent with a pre-funded wallet is auto-created for the user on signup, scoped API keys give the user control over which agent can spend, and the introspect-token API provides real-time balance/usability checks; committed-amount and charge-balance mechanics further reinforce user-controlled spend limits. Runtime probe confirms the token API is live and key-gated as documented, corroborating first-party claims. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the funding flow itself (e.g. actually depositing funds) and more detail on ongoing balance top-up/withdrawal beyond the enterprise Credits Wallet Embed SDK.
